text:
marco: Heads-up — prospect (MediTrust) needs SOC2 attestation + signed pen-test letter before starting a one-week private POC. They want this within 10 business days.
elaine: Do we have anything signed we can share immediately?
security-bot: We can share: SOC2 attestation summary PDF, control matrix CSV, and network diagram. Signed pen-test letter only after assessor engagement.
ops-amy: Private POC setup fee is $2,000. Expedited pen-test signing is an add-on (~$5,500 partner fee) and depends on assessor calendar (est. 3-5 business days after payment).
marco: Customer offered to pay for the expedited add-on if we can confirm 7 business day delivery. Can we promise that?
security-bot: We can commit to start scheduling immediately after payment. Recommend contract language: "Signed pen-test letter to be delivered within 7 business days following payment and scheduling confirmation, subject to assessor availability."
elaine: I'll add redaction and delivery method (secure SFTP or DLP share). Marco — draft reply and CC legal.
marco: Will do, thanks.
